summary: The Backrooms is a persistent multiplayer survival RPG across an authored Level 0 maze, deeper destinations and a social mall. `templates/player.js` composes player behaviors; player state owns individual progression, while place simulations and shared scripts implement environments, NPCs, combat, loot, quests and appearance. Quest tracking now guides players to valid level crossings, and place simulations share a system that dresses those thresholds in environmental clues.
places: places/main (3D) - authored Level 0/Lobby maze; sim generates maze furniture/loot, safe rooms, shifting walls, creature ecology, route guidance, Kade and Zenith's sealed breach.
places/bonus (3D) - vaporwave mall with authored shops and landmarks, simulated staff/shoppers, arcade and salon; escalator decor and moving steps have motor hum.
places/intake + places/tutorial0 (3D; tutorial0 solo ephemeral) - character creation/waking space and staged tutorial route with HALOGEN.
places/level01 (3D) - Level 0.1 Zenith Station: station/gallery, doors, breakables, bots/hazards, climate rooms, recorder quest and drone-refilled posts.
places/level1, places/level2, places/level21 (3D) - Habitable Zone garage maze and M.E.G. camp; Pipe Dreams industrial rooms/camp/fixtures; Level 2.1 Locked.
places/level3, places/gamma, places/level4, places/level5 (3D) - Electrical Station, Base Gamma, Abandoned Office and Terror Hotel; authored residents and fixtures.

places/level6, places/level7, places/level8, places/level10, places/level11, places/level12 (3D) - later destinations including drowned house, caves, farmland, generated city/canal/bridges and renovation office.

places/level26, places/level27, places/level184, places/level61, places/spamton, places/testlab, places/home11 (3D) - SS Fun cruise liner, Bunker Springs, Field of Forgotten Forts, Snackrooms, special destination, Test Range and player home; level26's sim only dresses its authored ship's thresholds.
roots: world.config.yaml + templates/player.js - multiplayer entry, player/camera setup, ordered behavior composition and keyboard/touch action mappings.
places/<place>/config.yaml + cells/*.scene + sim.js - place configuration, authored placements and local generated/ticked behavior; each simulation is the local place entry.

scripts/main-menu.js + scripts/main-menu-ui.js + intake/tutorial scripts - title/pause, character creation, arrival, tutorial routing, first-arrival cutscene, body-style toggle and solo pause time-scale.
places/level1/sim.js + scripts/lib/level1.js + Level 1 geometry scripts - seeded ground-floor/deck generation and shared deck/ramp layout.

scripts/camera.js + scripts/view3.js + scripts/ui.js + scripts/loot-ui.js - camera, third-person toggle, HUD/panels and inventory/equipment/quick-slot UI; player.js builds local first-person arms and held viewmodels.
scripts/quest-marker.js + scripts/lib/quests.js + scripts/lib/quest-mark.js + scripts/lib/quest-route.js - player journal/tracking, objective resolution and local or crossing-directed world markers.
scripts/lib/dina-quest.js + places/level1/cells/x0z0.scene - Dina camp/diary quest entry; Voss and Cabin 23/Phoebe/stow-nest interactions are in Level 26.
places/bonus/cells/x0z0.scene + places/testlab/sim.js - authored mall/escalator assembly and Test Range-generated armory, firing/physics bays, interactables and Loot Lab.
shared: scripts/lib/hub.js - shared/solo room IDs, Bonus Room and home destinations/crossings, LEVEL_NAMES used by hub-ui; includes Test Range.

scripts/lib/loot.js + scripts/lib/items.js + scripts/lib/weapons.js/weapons.yml - common loot spawning, container rolls, remains, place pools, item descriptions, weapon definitions/rarity and variants.
scripts/door-geo.js + scripts/lib/door-swing.js - parametric leaf/frame/sealed-set geometry and eased hinge motion shared by built and level-specific doors.
scripts/lib/thresholds.js + scripts/threshold-geo.js - discover/place door threshold dressing shared by participating place simulations; geometry is parameterized by clue kind.
scripts/lib/quest-route.js + scripts/lib/quest-mark.js - graph of level crossings and quest objective resolver; filters gated routes and selects a nearby valid exit.
scripts/lib/level11-vaults.js + scripts/lib/level11-depths.js + scripts/l11-crawl-geo.js + Level 11 data - security gates, crawl geometry, rooms, foe roster and storeroom.

scripts/lib/build-piece.js + scripts/lib/data/breakables.yml + scripts/lib/data/furniture.yml - canonical breakable/material/build specs and furniture models shared by B-mode, harvesting and reconstruction.

scripts/lib/critter-model.js + cat-wardrobe.js + wardrobe/clothes data + mat-catskin.js/mat-hair.js - player/NPC human, legacy furry and Tripo cat appearance paths; wardrobe data and fitted assets are shared.
notableExports: scripts/lib/thresholds.js - dressThresholds; scripts/threshold-geo.js - threshold dressing geometry/material builders.
scripts/lib/quests.js - MAX_TRACK, TINT, PLACE_NAMES, qid, setQuest, endQuest, tracked, toggleTrack.

scripts/lib/loot.js - POOL, poolOf, rollWeapon, gateItems, rollLock, rollCash, rollItem, spawnCrate and Level 2 container/loot helpers; scripts/lib/weapons.js - baseOf, variantOf, rollVariant, rarityIdx, rarityCap, default.
scripts/player.js - maxHp, maxSan, xpNeed, weaponOf, gain, takeToken, useSnack, onInput, hitTarget, fishNibble, HOLO/holoEnd and throwable callbacks.
scripts/critter.js - update, onInput and face/blink handlers; scripts/lib/critter-model.js - setStyle, HUMAN, STYLE_V, isNewCat, catLook, seatCat, restylePlace/Queue/Step and appearance builders.
scripts/lib/cat-wardrobe.js - CAT_BODY, CAT_OLD, CAT_BODY2, paintOf, skinParams, EYE_COLORS, SHADOWS, catModel, chestOf, SNOUTS, catMorph, catChildren; scripts/mat-hair.js - shader lighting.
scripts/lib/body3.js - heldRot, famOf, play, tick3, swing3, fire3, handle3, react3, stagger3, aimPose, aimMode, longHands, stance; scripts/lib/vmpose.js - VM_FOV, poseViewmodel.
ownership: scripts/player.js - persistent player.state progression, health/sanity, inventory/equipment/ammo, needs, money, appearance, combat/rewards, level access, saved place/position, wakeAtSave restoration, heat/cold and carried tapes/playback.

scripts/lib/quests.js owns player.state.quests, qtrack and qdone; level quest handlers own their quest-specific fields; scripts/lib/dina-quest.js owns dinaQ, dinaDiary and dcut and seeds the-way-back.
scripts/kick.js + scripts/grab.js - per-player kick rolls/cooldowns, carried prop/body IDs, held-body grip, drag/heave/throw session fields and carryMul; held targets own heldBy/down/stagger state.

scripts/lib/loose.js + scripts/lib/breakables.js - loose props own state.loose/mat/hp and flight sessions; breakables own wreck transitions and permanently smashed root IDs in place.state.gone; both guard Bonus.
scripts/lib/knock.js + scripts/lib/stats.js - foe attributes/weight and shared down/stagger knock outcomes; enemy managers retain AI state and write player-targeting sneakTarget.
places/level1/sim.js, places/level2/sim.js, places/level4/sim.js and places/level27/sim.js - place-state migration/version markers and one-time conversions (officeV, islandSplit in Level 4).

scripts/lib/prop-interactions.js + scripts/prop-part.js - prop state owns interactiveV, propArt, containerOpen/lampOn and part motion goals; child sessions track native tween keys while prop parts animate from replicated state.

scripts/lib/thresholds.js owns place.state.thrSeen/thrTry/thrDone/thrV for delayed, versioned threshold placement; testlab owns place lootPool/labV and consumes pad requests for board rolls/crates/remains.
flows: world.config.yaml actions → templates/player.js ordered behaviors for locomotion, player/foe steps, swim/climb, interact/grab/kick/rest/mahjong/talk/build/noclip/stats/craft/OS/lockpick/fights/horde/critter/menu/hub/view3/quest markers.
world.config.yaml camera → scripts/camera.js; view3 writes player.state.tp/orbit → third-person camera; camera writes aimPt and ranged aimPitch → player.js ballistics.

scripts/routing.js accepts permitted requested rooms; otherwise scripts/lib/hub.js soloRoom selects the player's solo Backrooms room and bonus overflow IDs; toHub/toSolo perform crossings and track roomHop/save-place state.

Fresh visit → scripts/main-menu.js; START enters intake for creation or bonus for completed characters; wardrobe close runs intro-cut then tutorial0 unless t0Done; menu UI renders on menuOpen and solo pause sets place.timeScale.

Main-menu BODIES action → player.state.bodyStyle and world.state.bodyStyle; scripts/lib/critter-model.js setStyle selects human mode only for 'human', otherwise furry; Bonus sim applies this before NPC updates/redress.

scripts/lib/hub.js destinations → hub-ui.js and hub.js crossings; Bonus sim lays NPCs/effects and mall counters write shop/food state consumed by handlers/UI; Bonus escalator step entities run scripts/esc-step.js from their feet position.
Found loot search → scripts/interact.js calls loot.gateItems for non-storage/non-NPC contents; rarity caps are 1-2 common, 3-5 uncommon, 6-9 rare, 10+ elite; weapon variants roll through weapons.js.

interact.js focus → player.state.focus and loot-ui.js prompt only on the play screen; ui-theme/screen hide prompts behind panels; interact.js clears focus outlines in menus/talk/cutscenes/build mode. Talk UI emits talk/talkdo/shop actions.

interact.js openLoot/closeLoot → prop-interactions.containerPose → child part state.goal; scripts/prop-part.js samples cubic motion and builtin tween animates articulated storage fronts; toggleLamp flips light part goals.

scripts/lib/prop-interactions.js interactiveSpec → generated furniture from scripts/lib/furniture.js and upgradeNearby nearby legacy props; preserves root collider/state and tags; prop-part children provide moving doors/drawers/lids.

Player craft action/UI → scripts/lib/craft.js stationOf + craft.yml; built pieces in breakables.yml carry bench=cook/ammo and state.station; craft.js/craft-ui.js filter station recipes while hand menu lists all recipes.

Tracked quest → quest-marker.js calls questMark; same-place objectives resolve directly, remote objectives use nextQuestExit's gated crossing graph → marker and quest journal/UI show the next crossing. Place sims call dressThresholds → scans crossing doors and lays authored-style signs/clues once after colliders stand.
behaviorFamilies: places/bonus/cells/x0z0.scene + objects.scene + scripts/lib/data/bonus.yml + places/bonus/sim.js + bonus-extra and mall shopper/salon scripts - authored mall, NPC attachments and simulation; escalator decor has frozen steps removed and moving steps carry motor behavior.

art/bonus-mall/escalator.py + world.assets bonus-mall-deco-moving-escalators/escalator-step + scripts/esc-step.js - offline Blender build makes reusable detailed steps; placements vary direction and phase while sharing motor behavior.
scripts/lib/data/furniture.yml + scripts/lib/build-piece.js + scripts/build.js + home reconstruction scripts - per-piece models/dimensions with common placement, persistence and rebuild path.

scripts/door-geo.js + scripts/lib/door-swing.js and scripts/lib/prop-interactions.js + interactive-props.yml + prop-part.js - parametric/eased doors and animated storage parts, fitted to supported kinds and migrated while preserving existing props.

scripts/lib/thresholds.js + scripts/threshold-geo.js + participating places/*/sim.js - shared environmental dressing at crossings; kind, destination and inward direction determine the placed sign/clue.
places/level01/sim.js + scripts/zenith-geo.js + scripts/zenith-breach-geo.js + Zenith door/bots/hatch/flicker/drones/use scripts - Zenith Station geometry, breach, hazards and interactive systems.

places/level4 scenes + places/level4/sim.js + scripts/l4-office.js/l4-office-geo.js/l4-home.js + Level 4/5 resident data - authored office/hotel props, fixtures, NPC bodies and attached critter behavior.

scripts/lib/cat-wardrobe.js + cat-wardrobe.yml + critter-faces.yml + mat-catskin.js/mat-hair.js + art/cat-wardrobe builders - Tripo cat appearance with morph-carrying skinned hair/fluff and painted or fitted clothes.
probableOrphans: scripts/balloon26-geo.js - exports procedural balloon geometry/skeleton/collider but Level 26 scene placements and barrage use uploaded models instead.
scripts/hairtest-rig.js - header marks it as a temporary hair lane test rig; no tree/package references found.
art/critter-hair-tripo/fit.py.held - saved tune-aware fitter copy with no references found; active fit.py is the fitter used by its documented Blender command.
scripts/dbg-pose.js - debug-room mannequin gallery behavior; the former places/debug was removed and no current placements reference it.

scripts/dbg-bodypad.js, scripts/debug-pad.js, scripts/lib/debug-layout.js - debug-room-specific body/warp/heal pads and layout helper; former places/debug was removed and no current placements reference these scripts.
migrationNotes: Avatar STYLE_V is sw178; new Tripo cats use reshaped CAT_BODY for both sexes; CAT_OLD names previous body assets and CAT_BODY2 is an alias, not a look.base2 selector. Keep human and legacy non-cat paths separate.
Game Tripo cat selection requires !HUMAN, MESH and speciesOf(look) === 'cat'; cats use catModel/catMorph/catChildren, while human mode and other species do not use the cat wardrobe.

Cat look.snout/ears/tail drive named body shape keys; fitted hair and fluff carry catMorph so facial shapes follow the head; sculpted ear assets are skinned children, and hairstyle coverage suppresses crown fluff that would intersect.

Cat chest slider is 0..1 mapped by chestOf to Chest 0.15..1; fitted clothing must preserve the Chest key. Cat skin and hair materials shade models in bind-pose coordinates; keep shader/model coordinate conventions aligned.

player.js's cat first-person arm comes from critterSpec with topw sleeve child; tail bones are cut from the local rig. Keep camera.yml critterEye consistent with cat shot origin and scaled cat eye height.

Threshold dressing is versioned by place.state.thrV (currently V=6), delayed until place colliders stand and laid incrementally; keep upgrades idempotent and preserve the thr-tag cleanup/version protocol.
